polity.canonical_name_en: Kabyle Resistance to the French Conquest

activity.notes: Lalla Fatma N'Soumer played an attested leadership role in mobilizing Kabyle resistance from 1854 and remained a central figure until her capture in July 1857. ATLAS does not make her a sovereign ruler of a timeless Kabylia or Berbery civilization.

sources.title: Lalla Fatma N’Soumer (1830–1863): Spirituality, Resistance and Womanly Leadership in Colonial Algeria
sources.citation_text: The scholarly study identifies her attested role in mobilizing fighters in 1854 and traces her resistance leadership through her capture by French forces in July 1857.

sources.title: Armed resistance in the Djurdjura Kabylia region, 1850–1857
sources.citation_text: The Algerian historical journal article states that after Boubaghla's death in 1854 Lalla Fatma N'Soumer continued the resistance until July 1857.

review_context.correction_note: Collapse both game slots into one historically attested Kabyle resistance Activity; no duplicate Berbery polity.
